The '''Treadwell Harvester Droid''' was a model of [[Agrirobot/Legends|agricultural droid]]. The [[Harvester droid/Legends|harvester droid]] was equipped with cutter blades, and had a [[Armor/Legends|protective blast-plate]] that covered the unit's crawler treads. Treadwell Harvester Droids were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]].<ref name="HNNA" />
